components.purpose: Full-width opening banner. It renders under the menu, has a heading, description, and two CTA links (cta1, cta2) for the two buttons.
Customer logos. It has a nested list of logo items and an optional CTA.

Features grid with screenshots. Its description calls it a good way to showcase screenshots, and its cards are nested with a heading and subheading. FeatureGrid was rejected because its FeatureItem model only has an icon, not a screenshot.
Three key stats. It has a heading, description, and a nested list of stats (value + label) that can hold three entries.
One customer quote. It is a single-testimonial dropdown linked to TestimonialItem. The plural Testimonials component shows a list, so it doesn't fit a single quote.
Final contact form. It has a heading, description, submit URL, success/error messages, and office contact details.
